notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Synod Artificer.
Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat for infinite mana.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's last ability to draw infinite cards.
